checks.title: Query mode
checks.detail: Switched Discover to ES|QL for a repeatable pipeline.

checks.title: Grouped calculation
checks.detail: Ran a grouped calculation to surface ${truth.finding}.

checks.title: Result interpretation
checks.detail: Read the decisive row's values to confirm it.

answer.evidence: The grouped ES|QL result identifies ${truth.finding} with ${truth.scope}.

goals.title: Use ES|QL for the analysis
goals.concept: In ES|QL mode the query selects data, and data-view field statistics are unavailable.
goals.reasoning: This question needs an aggregation expressed as a query pipeline.
goals.evidence: The editor is in ES|QL mode.

demonstration.narration: I'll switch to ES|QL so we can calculate groups by ${var.field} instead of only listing individual events.
demonstration.reasoning:
KQL filters documents but does not express this grouped calculation.

ES|QL lets one pipeline select the source data, restrict rows, calculate statistics, group on ${var.field}, and order the result.
demonstration.evidence: The query editor is now in ES|QL mode. We can calculate grouped results, but have not identified the decisive group yet.

hints: Use the query mode designed for tabular transformations.
Open the language selector in Discover.
Choose ES|QL; Show me can switch modes.

goals.title: Build the requested aggregation
goals.concept: WHERE narrows input; STATS calculates per-group measures; SORT makes the decisive row visible.
goals.narration: Run an ES|QL pipeline that groups and compares the relevant values.
goals.reasoning: Result semantics matter more than exact formatting.
goals.evidence: The result table has one row per ${var.field} group, and the decisive group is among them.

demonstration.narration: I'll run a grouped query by ${var.field} so we can compare the measures behind this incident side by side.
demonstration.reasoning: Each pipeline stage has a distinct job. Filtering before STATS keeps unrelated rows out of the measures; grouping and sorting let us compare the resulting values.
demonstration.evidence: The result table now contains one row per ${var.field} group and the calculated values. Compare the rows to identify which group stands out.

hints: Build a pipeline from source selection to grouped statistics.
Use FROM, then STATS … BY ${var.field}, then SORT so the decisive row comes first.
Group on ${var.field}; Show me can run the reference pipeline.

goals.title: Interpret the decisive result
goals.concept: An analytical answer must report what the calculated values mean, not just the query text.
goals.narration: Select or inspect the decisive result row.
goals.reasoning: The row supplies the quantitative evidence for the conclusion.
goals.evidence: The expected comparison is present in the result.

demonstration.narration: I'll read the leading row's group and values together to check that the numbers support the conclusion.
demonstration.reasoning:
A top-ranked name without its numbers is not enough evidence, and numbers without the group key have no owner.

Reading both parts verifies that the query result supports the intended comparison rather than merely returning rows.
demonstration.evidence:
The decisive row should pair ${truth.finding} with ${truth.scope}.

Those concrete values corroborate the aggregation and justify the conclusion: ${truth.conclusion}

hints: Read the leading row and compare its calculated columns.
Expand the first row of the ES|QL table to read its values together.
Focus on ${var.field}; Show me can point to it.

goals.title: Submit the comparison
goals.concept: Report the compared groups or periods, decisive values, and conclusion.
goals.narration: Record the analytical conclusion with evidence.
goals.reasoning: A result table becomes useful only when its implication is stated.
goals.evidence: The response cites the aggregation result.
hints: State which row or period is decisive, with its numbers.
Use the coach's comparison form: the decisive group, its values, and what they mean.
Submit the finding, the decisive values and the conclusion; Show me shows the reference summary.
